readme: Top-3 in-band candidates per store x commodity, cheapest-per-unit first. validate-fills.ps1 runs each product NAME through the real compare-deals Match-Category and keeps the cheapest candidate that actually resolves to the intended commodity. A candidate that would land in a different commodity's cell is rejected, not shipped.
